unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #8 "Add a Nano (XNO) settlement rail behind the policy firewall — a self-custodial leg the guard can vouch for" on KalpeshM13/AgentPay-Guard. Argued in its own security terms: the guard never lets the agent own credentials, and Nano is a self-generated keypair with no registry/KYC/fee, so the public confirmed block is the immutable receipt the after-the-fact validation needs; carried live Vend nano-info endpoint. https://github.com/KalpeshM13/AgentPay-Guard/issues/8
